sources.notes: Web calibration on 2026-09-09 found direct-topic papers (arXiv:2603.02139 fisheye camera choice in robotic manipulation; arXiv:2608.02257 panorama-aware VLA; arXiv:2604.13476 RobotPan surround-view; arXiv:2606.04708 VISTA fisheye UMI adaptation; arXiv:2603.05868 AnyCamVLA zero-shot camera adaptation), plus industrial signals (AGIBOT G2 humanoid ships fisheye cameras) and adjacent families (ODGS-SLAM omnidirectional GS-SLAM, SysNav 360-camera navigation, RoboSense fisheye-equipped dataset).

queries.label: dynamic-fisheye-robot-broad
queries.why: Broadest recall for fisheye lenses used in any robotic context; downstream screening separates embodied applications from ADAS surround-view.

queries.label: dynamic-fisheye-manipulation
queries.why: Direct: fisheye wrist/body cameras in manipulation policies (e.g. Rethinking Camera Choice, Give Human a Robot Hand).

queries.label: dynamic-fisheye-vla
queries.why: Direct: VLA policies trained on or adapted to fisheye observations (VISTA, PanoVLA family).

queries.label: dynamic-panorama-vla-mobile
queries.why: Panorama-aware VLA for mobile manipulation is a 2026 direct-topic family (PanoVLA).

queries.label: dynamic-wide-fov-robot
queries.query: all:"wide field of view" AND all:robot
queries.why: Mechanism: wide-FoV benefits (spatial localization, context) phrased without the word fisheye.

queries.label: dynamic-fisheye-distortion-policy
queries.why: Mechanism: radial distortion modeling, rectification, and their interaction with learned policies.

queries.label: dynamic-cross-camera-generalization
queries.why: Limit surface: policies that overfit to one camera model (pinhole vs fisheye); AnyCamVLA/ICWM family.

queries.label: dynamic-camera-adaptation-robot
queries.why: Limit surface: zero-shot camera/viewpoint adaptation as the response to fisheye-vs-pinhole domain gaps.

queries.label: dynamic-fisheye-benchmark
queries.why: Evaluation: benchmarks and datasets that include fisheye sensors for robot perception (RoboSense-style).

queries.label: dynamic-omnidirectional-navigation
queries.why: Evaluation/deployment: omnidirectional-camera navigation systems (SysNav 360-camera object navigation).

queries.label: dynamic-fisheye-humanoid
queries.why: Deployment: humanoid platforms shipping fisheye cameras (AGIBOT G2, NICO stereo fisheye).

queries.label: dynamic-surround-view-robot
queries.query: all:"surround view" AND all:robot AND all:perception
queries.why: Deployment: 360 surround-view vision systems on embodied platforms (RobotPan on Tiangong humanoid).

queries.label: dynamic-360-camera-robot
queries.why: Deployment: 360-degree panoramic cameras as robot input or teleoperation interface.

queries.label: dynamic-fisheye-slam
queries.why: Adjacent: fisheye/omnidirectional SLAM underpins embodied localization (ODGS-SLAM, multi-fisheye VIO); screen for robot context.

queries.label: dynamic-panoramic-teleop-data
queries.why: Adjacent: panoramic cameras in whole-body teleoperation and demonstration data collection.

queries.label: dynamic-fisheye-detection
queries.query: all:fisheye AND (all:detection OR all:segmentation) AND all:robot
queries.why: Adjacent: fisheye perception modules (detection/segmentation) consumed by robot stacks.

browser_fallback_queries.label: dynamic-fisheye-embodied-browser
browser_fallback_queries.why: Recover papers whose abstracts use fisheye-adjacent wording missed by API field search.

web_calibration_queries.label: dynamic-fisheye-vlm-robustness-web
web_calibration_queries.query: fisheye distortion VLM robustness robot 2026 arXiv
web_calibration_queries.why: Check whether VLM-on-fisheye robustness studies form a distinct 2026 paper family.
